gaps.note: Tensor products are outside the reader's background (the profile excludes them), and the page does not explain or link them. The definition of U_a, and hence the claim that each U_a is a line, depends on it.

gaps.quote: $s$ is the total number of smaller calls
gaps.note: The page never says what a smaller call is. It only says each unit of rational rank is one smaller interchange, which is itself undefined.

gaps.quote: Changing a label's dimension by some amount costs that many smaller calls
gaps.note: The reader cannot check why the cost equals the rank of the difference of the two projections, nor why the total s is the sum of these ranks over all edges. The page gives no cost model to verify this from.

gaps.quote: Labels at the two ends of an edge are nested, so one contains the other.
gaps.note: This is a property of the page's own construction, attributed only to a citation. The page never states what the labels of gates and terminals are, so the reader cannot see why they nest or why the citation applies here.

The page does not define the sign convention of the signed sum, nor which vertices are sources and sinks, so the reader cannot check that gate contributions cancel to sinks minus sources or that the absolute-change sum equals Wm-2N+2L.

gaps.quote: Every sink label is the whole space
gaps.note: The page never says how many sinks there are or that there is one sink of dimension m per wire, so the total Wm-N cannot be checked from what the page gives.
The reader cannot tell which vertices are sources or that each bank's source label is U_a, so the count N of sources is not checkable from the page.

gaps.quote: The rational interface adds one rank per bank
gaps.note: The page does not define the rational interface or the source matrix of X_a, so the claim that each bank adds exactly rank one, giving s = Wm-N+2L, cannot be checked.

gaps.quote: so only the two ends of a route matter

gaps.quote: The only decreasing edges are central-wire returns
gaps.note: The term is not explained or linked, and the page does not show why these are the only decreasing edges or why each loses exactly h dimensions. The value of L depends on this.
